artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\omega_1$ denote the first uncountable ordinal and let $[\omega_1]^2$ denote the set of unordered pairs of distinct countable ordinals. An ordinal metric is a function $\varrho:[\omega_1]^2\to\omega$ such that:
(i) $\varrho(\alpha,\gamma)\le\max\{\varrho(\alpha,\beta),\varrho(\beta,\gamma)\}$ for all $\alpha<\beta<\gamma<\omega_1$;
(ii) for every $\alpha<\omega_1$ and every $n<\omega$, the set $\{\xi<\alpha:\varrho(\xi,\alpha)\le n\}$ is finite;
(iii) for every uncountable family $\mathcal{A}$ of finite subsets of $\omega_1$ consisting of pairwise disjoint sets of the same cardinality, and every $n<\omega$, there exist $A,B\in\mathcal{A}$ with $\max A<\min B$ and $\varrho(\alpha,\beta)>n$ for all $\alpha\in A$, $\beta\in B$.

For $n<\omega$ and $\alpha<\omega_1$, define
$$F_n(\alpha):=\{\xi\le\alpha:\varrho(\xi,\alpha)\le n\}\subseteq\omega_1,$$
where $\varrho(\alpha,\alpha)$ is interpreted as $0$. Let
$$\mathcal{F}_\varrho:=\{F_n(\alpha):n<\omega,\ \alpha<\omega_1\},$$
identify each element of $\mathcal{F}_\varrho$ with its characteristic function in $\{0,1\}^{\omega_1}$, and let $K_\varrho\subseteq\{0,1\}^{\omega_1}$ be the closure of $\mathcal{F}_\varrho$ in the product (pointwise) topology.

A Markushevich basis (M-basis) of a Banach space $X$ is a biorthogonal system $\{(x_i,x_i^*)\}_{i\in I}\subseteq X\times X^*$ such that $\overline{\mathrm{span}}\{x_i:i\in I\}=X$ and $\{x_i^*:i\in I\}$ separates points of $X$. The M-basis is called norming if the closed linear subspace $\overline{\mathrm{span}}^{\,w^*}\{x_i^*:i\in I\}$ is a norming subspace of $X^*$, i.e., there exists $c>0$ such that
$$\|x\|\le c\sup\{|x^*(x)|:x^*\in B_{X^*}\cap\overline{\mathrm{span}}^{\,w^*}\{x_i^*:i\in I\}\}\quad\text{for all }x\in X.$$

Question: Does the Banach space $C(K_\varrho)$ of continuous real-valued functions on $K_\varrho$, equipped with the supremum norm, admit a norming Markushevich basis?

status_evidence.title: Banach spaces of continuous functions without norming Markushevich bases
status_evidence.snippet: Recent results on C(K) spaces lacking norming M-bases; leaves open whether scattered cases such as the construction here admit one.
status_evidence.claim: Related recent work does not resolve this specific question.
